scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A finite-time singularity of Calabi flow on projective space” (preprints/A-finite-time-singularity-of-Calabi-flow-on-projective-space-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 352 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 486e9e5ff47e92a4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a smooth U(10)-invariant Kähler form ω0 on CP10 , in the class [ωFS], whose maximal smooth Calabi flow has existence interval [0, T∗) with 0 < T∗ < ∞. There are a point p ∈ CP10 and a constant a > 0 such that S(ω(t))(p) ∼ a(T∗ − t)−1/2 as t ↑ T∗.
